sqlquery.from: (SELECT cc.id, (COALESCE(cc.firstname, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(cc.lastname, '')) as fullname, SUM(COALESCE(clientbalance, 0)) AS balance, (select cur.name from company c left join financialsettings fs on fs.id = financialsettingsid left join currency cur on cur.id = fs.currency_id where c.id = $) as currency FROM "$".crmaccount ca INNER JOIN "$".crmAccount_types typeIDs on typeIDs.crmaccount_id = ca.id INNER JOIN "$".reference types on types.id = typeIDs.type_id LEFT JOIN "$".crmContact cc ON cc.crmAccount = ca.id WHERE types.code = 'CUSTOMER' and cc.deleted = false and ca.deleted = false and COALESCE(clientbalance, 0) > 0 GROUP BY cc.id, fullname, currency ORDER BY balance DESC) t
